metricSemantics.contentAssertions: Declared any/all keyword policy only; it is not overwritten by lifecycle or ledger failures.
metricSemantics.toolAttempt: Required tool names/count appeared in tool_invocation regardless of terminal tool status.
metricSemantics.toolSuccess: Every expectSuccessfulToolsAll capability reached successful tool_invocation status.
metricSemantics.assertions: Content, tool-attempt, and tool-success checks all pass; this is a deterministic correctness proxy, not human semantic grading.
metricSemantics.endToEndSuccess: Assertions pass, the canonical Agent Loop lifecycle is complete, CompletionGate passes with stopReason=COMPLETED, and dialogue_run reaches STATUS_SUCCESS.
metricSemantics.verification: verification_started/result are CompletionGate lifecycle events. verifierExecuted distinguishes an independent final verifier from deterministic gate checks.
metricSemantics.completionBlocked: Number of same-loop completion rejections that returned required actions to the model before another turn.
metricSemantics.stopReason: Typed terminal reason emitted by run_finished/result; successful runs must end with COMPLETED.
metricSemantics.tokens: Provider-reported usage persisted from Spring AI response metadata; runs without provider usage are excluded, never replaced by TokenCounter.countText().
metricSemantics.latency: Client wall-clock time from Gateway request start through the terminal SSE frame.
